# Kopor

> Kopor is a free, offline-first business and money app for Sierra Leone, made by Abdulai Bah. It works in English, Krio and French, on Android and the web.

## What it does
- Credit book (trust book) with reminders by SMS and WhatsApp
- Cash book, daily profit and an evening closing summary
- Stock, low-stock alerts and restock orders to suppliers
- Mobile money payments (Orange Money, Africell money) through Monime, with reversal alerts
- Osusu groups, savings jars, invoices, receipts, instalments and layaway
- US dollar rate in Leones, checked every hour
- Staff logins, branches and an owner's view
- Krio voice assistant

## Price
- Free for one shop with up to 3 staff
- Kopor Pro: Le 75 a month
